dossier.label: operational dossier
dossier.a1: OTC (over-the-counter) means trading directly between two parties, outside exchange order books. For large volumes: price locked before execution, zero slippage and dedicated coverage — all documented.
dossier.a2: Yes. A formally incorporated company, KYC/AML on every trade, contracts and receipts for each negotiation, and crypto transaction reporting to Brazil's Federal Revenue Service under Normative Instruction 1888/2019.
dossier.a3: Trades from R$ 100k. Below that, a traditional exchange tends to be more efficient for your case.
dossier.a4: Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins (USDT, USDC) and the leading crypto assets. Others on request.
dossier.a5: You share asset and volume; the desk returns a firm price, valid for a short window. Once accepted, the price holds for the entire trade — recorded in contract.
dossier.a6: In the vast majority of cases, same business day (T+0), in fiat or crypto, with full confirmation.
dossier.a7: Onboarding with KYC verification — individual or corporate. Once approved, the desk is at your disposal.
footer.disclaimer: Crypto assets involve risk, including high volatility and possible loss of invested capital. This website is informational and does not constitute investment advice.
inst.label: the desk
inst.text: A trading desk built for institutional investors and large portfolios: direct coverage, global liquidity and compliance discipline at every step — from first contact to settlement.
inst.p1.d: A specialist follows every trade from start to finish. No queues, no tickets, no middlemen.
inst.p2.d: Simultaneous access to multiple liquidity venues to guarantee the best price, at any trade size.
inst.p3.d: KYC/AML, contracts and receipts on every trade. A structure compliant with Brazilian regulation.
